item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 18 November 2026(Wednesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Laguna (Santa Maria, Mabitac, Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Rizal, San Pablo, Cavinti, Famy, Kalayaan, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Siniloan, Liliw, and Los Banos), Quezon (Sariaya, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Calauag, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Lopez, Macalelon, Padre Burgos, Pitogo, Plaridel, Quezon, Tagkawayan, Unisan, General Nakar, Dolores, and Candelaria), and Rizal (Tanay, Pililla, Jala-Jala, Baras, Morong, Cardona, Binangonan, Teresa, Antipolo, and Angono) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Laguna (Pila, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Pagsanjan, and Lumban) and Quezon (Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo, Patnanungan, Jomalig, and Perez) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
